title: Cauchy-Schwarz on (-a, a): ∫ g <= sqrt(2a ∫ g^2)
statement: Let g : R -> R be a function, a > 0, and suppose g^2 is integrable on the open interval (-a, a) for Lebesgue measure. Then ∫_{(-a,a)} g <= sqrt(2a ∫_{(-a,a)} g^2) (Bochner integrals).
lean_statement: ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ), 0 < a → IntegrableOn (fun s => g s ^ 2) (Ioo (-a) a) → (∫ s in Ioo (-a) a, g s) ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * a * ∫ s in Ioo (-a) a, g s ^ 2)
